description.zh: 搜索和读取 Notion 工作区内容，并创建或更新页面。
description.en: Search and read Notion workspace content, and create or update pages.

description.zh: 读取和管理 Xmind 中国版账号中的思维导图。
description.en: Read and manage mind maps in your Xmind China account.

description.zh: 查询地点、路线、距离和天气等高德地图服务。
description.en: Query places, routes, distances, weather, and other Amap services.

description.zh: 查询地点、地理编码、路线和行政区划等百度地图服务。
description.en: Query places, geocoding, routes, administrative areas, and other Baidu Maps services.

description.zh: 通过腾讯文档 MCP 访问和处理你的文档内容。
description.en: Access and work with your Tencent Docs content through MCP.

description.zh: 查询工商登记、股东与实际控制人、企业关联、经营风险、行政处罚和知识产权等数据。
description.en: Look up company registration, shareholders and controllers, related businesses, operating risks, administrative penalties, and intellectual property.

description.zh: 以只读方式搜索和查看代码仓库、文件、提交、版本发布、Issue 与 Pull Request。
description.en: Search and view repositories, files, commits, releases, issues, and pull requests in read-only mode.

description.zh: 查询和管理 Gitee 仓库、代码文件、Issue、Pull Request 与评论，辅助代码协作。
description.en: Access Gitee repositories and files, and manage issues, pull requests and comments for development collaboration.

name.zh: 腾讯地图（腾讯位置服务）

description.zh: 搜索地点、解析地址、规划驾车与公共交通等路线，查询距离和天气，帮助安排出行。
description.en: Find places, geocode addresses, plan driving and public transport routes, and check distances and weather for travel planning.

description.zh: 查询航班动态、航线、机上舒适度、延误预测、机场天气、飞行轨迹及机场和航司运行统计。
description.en: Check flight status, routes, onboard amenities, delay forecasts, airport weather, flight tracks and airport or airline operating statistics.

description.zh: 查询地点与路线、预估打车费用，并按账号开通权限处理叫车、订单跟踪和取消等出行需求。
description.en: Look up places and routes, estimate ride fares, and handle ride booking, tracking and cancellation according to the account's enabled permissions.

description.zh: 查询股票行情、公司基本面、估值和相关金融数据，辅助股票研究与分析。
description.en: Retrieve stock prices, company fundamentals, valuations and related financial data for equity research and analysis.

description.zh: 查询航班动态、机场与航司信息，分析已授权的个人行程，并获取票价和出行规划信息。
description.en: Check flight status, airport and airline information, analyze authorized personal trips, and access fare and travel-planning information.

description.zh: 预约、修改或取消会议，查询参会信息，检索有权访问的录制、转写和纪要。
description.en: Schedule, update, or cancel meetings, check attendance, and retrieve authorized recordings, transcripts, and meeting notes.

description.zh: 按机器人和用户授权查询群聊、消息及附件，列出机器人会话并发送消息。
description.en: List group chats, messages, attachments, and bot sessions, and send messages within the bot’s and user’s permissions.
